name: 退出と保管のチャンネル操作
prompt: Render one standalone polished Japanese Lighthouse UI component LH03-0068 退出と保管のチャンネル操作. ORIGINAL Slack screenshot is primary, specifically bottom region normalized390 x15..375 y601..742: two stacked wide white outline buttons followed by a small creator/date note. Preserve original control icon anatomy and purposeful red action. Japanese mock is secondary for exact localized content and native text sizes. Logical canvas390x170 white #FFFFFF, uniform high resolution scale. Button1 x16 y8 width358 height48, moderately rounded corners about14, thin RED-PINK outline #D92563, white face. Center a single combined icon+text group: original EXIT icon at left, a rounded open door/bracket with a horizontal arrow pointing RIGHT through its opening; NOT a paper plane or triangle. Icon and exact label 'チャンネルから退出' red-pink. Text Meiryo Bold14 lineheight24 tracking0. Button2 x16 y66 width358 height48, same corner shape, thin neutral-gray outline, white face. Original archive icon: rectangular storage box with gently rounded bottom corners and a wider thin lid on top plus short horizontal centered slot below lid; about17x17px. Text 'チャンネルを保管', Meiryo Bold14 #1D1D1D, icon dark slate #526173; center whole icon+label group. No green action or filled face. At x16 y138 small exact Japanese '山田 はるか が2026年5月29日に作成' on ONE line, Meiryo Regular12 lineheight16 tracking0. Preserve original creator-as-link hierarchy: only '山田 はるか' forest #1F6444, remainder #6E6E6E. Date/name are intentional authored Japanese adaptation. Match original thin outline optics and compact readable scale. No page frame, phone, Slack logo, English, extra subtitles, gradients, shadows, giant margins or additional controls. Artwork should display these two buttons and note only. Apple-design clear hierarchy and restrained materials.
reviewNotes: 原画像優先で紙飛行機を退出矢印へ修正し、赤系警告の白い枠ボタンと中立の蓋・短いスロット付き保管箱を復元。2つのBold14ラベル、Regular12の作成記録、forestの作成者リンクを目視確認。保存済み日本語名と2026年日付は原画像2024年からの適応。厳密な画素・フォント一致と実際の退出・保管動作は未検証。
